queries.compiledQueryString:
select
  occ2,
  soc2_name,
  concat(occ2, ' - ', soc2_name) as soc2_group,
  occ_rank,
  wa_id,
  wa_name,
  rca,
  mentions
from nlx.CMP_NlxOccupationFingerprint
where occ_rank <= 5
order by occ2, occ_rank
